name: Brief generator: OLLAMA_HOST fix + raw fallback
goal: Fix generate-sprint-brief.py so it (1) reads OLLAMA_HOST from .env instead of hardcoding localhost:11434, and (2) falls back to raw progress.md + git log when Ollama is unavailable — so every future session starts with a useful sprint brief regardless of vault connectivity.
rationale: The sprint brief has been showing [ERROR: Ollama call failed] because OLLAMA_HOST points to the Mac Mini vault via Tailscale, not localhost. Every future autonomous session is degraded because of this. Fix is small: load OLLAMA_HOST from .env, fall back gracefully if unreachable.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 file edit (generate-sprint-brief.py). Direct write.

tasks.title: generate-sprint-brief.py — use OLLAMA_HOST env + fallback
tasks.description: 1) Load OLLAMA_HOST from .env using dotenv or manual parse. OLLAMA_URL = f'{OLLAMA_HOST}/api/generate' (strip trailing slash). 2) Add make_fallback_brief() function: reads last 50 lines of progress.md (last 2-3 sprints), runs git log -5, assembles Current State + Recent Sprint History sections WITHOUT Qwen. 3) In generate_brief(): if any call_qwen() returns [ERROR...], call make_fallback_brief() instead of using the error strings.

tasks.title: validate-sprint-162.ts — 4-check validation
tasks.description: 1) generate-sprint-brief.py loads OLLAMA_HOST (not hardcoded localhost). 2) make_fallback_brief() or equivalent fallback function exists. 3) call_qwen error handling doesn't write [ERROR...] strings directly to brief. 4) Script can run dry without errors (python3 --check).

acceptance_criteria: Fallback function exists — uses progress.md + git log when Ollama unavailable
No [ERROR...] strings written directly to sprint-brief.md sections
